name: flow
description: “Flow” — who writes to whom in the fleet: you, the hub, agents and workers as dots, messages and tasks as signals between them; live and replayed over an hour, 6 hours or a day — at speeds from ×¼ to ×4, with pause and seeking
why: At a glance you see where work is going on and who waits for whom; the replay shows how the day went
